what: NDT-SCAN (2026-10-13): the step's whole-buffer passes on the pool. Before = a detached worktree of b47f860 (TRAIN-POLICY: the serial scans and fills), after = the NDT-SCAN tree, alternated minutes apart on one host at four threads under kblock+exp+reduce.
host: 4-vCPU Intel Xeon container (AVX-512), GCC 13.3 (the trainer builds), Python 3.11.15 (the declared floor); indicative wall times, no PMU

files.breakdown-bcir-kblock+exp+reduce-t4-{bef: six alternated pairs of the 2026-10-11 harness's bcir-breakdown stage (--rounds 5 --threads 4 --contract kblock+exp+reduce)
files.identity-{before,after}.json: the harness's identity stage, 20 steps at 1 and 4 threads: one state per tree, the same state on both
